aboutSection.p1: I’m a senior Android and full‑stack developer based in Bexley, England. I specialize in Kotlin, Next.js, and modern frontend stacks, with a strong focus on performance, design quality, and CI/CD automation.
aboutSection.p2: My work spans from advanced Android apps with Jetpack to production‑ready Next.js portfolios and Kotlin Ktor backends with comprehensive integration testing.
aboutSection.p3: I enjoy blending English and Burmese in technical content, experimenting with neon/glassmorphic UIs, and shipping polished, automated deployments.
